story_zh: 在寂静的农村，一位年轻的农民望着天空。他热爱诗歌，梦想创造独特的作品。他欣赏蝴蝶的翅膀，仿佛它们是生动的诗。他思考着成熟与青春的结合。一天，他朗读自己的诗，声音充满温暖。朋友们称赞他：“你的诗的确出色，像光明照亮了单调的日子。”他微笑，感受着梦想的果实。
story_pinyin: Zài jìjìng de nóngcūn, yī wèi niánqīng de nóngmín wàngzhe tiānkōng. Tā rè'ài shīgē, mèngxiǎng chuàngzào dútè de zuòpǐn. Tā xīnshǎng húdié de chìbǎng, fǎngfú tāmen shì shēngdòng de shī. Tā sīkǎo zhe chéngshú yǔ qīngchūn de jiéhé. Yī tiān, tā lǎngdú zìjǐ de shī, shēngyīn chōngmǎn wēnnuǎn. Péngyǒumen chēngzàn tā: “Nǐ de shī díquè chūsè, xiàng guāngmíng zhàoliàng le dāndiào de rìzi.” Tā wēixiào, gǎnshòu zhe mèngxiǎng de guǒshí.
story_en: In the silent countryside, a young farmer gazes at the sky. He loves poetry and dreams of creating unique works. He admires butterfly wings, as if they were vivid poems. He ponders the union of maturity and youth. One day, he reads his poem aloud, his voice brimming with warmth. Friends praise him: 'Your poem is indeed outstanding, like light illuminating monotonous days.' He smiles, feeling the fruits of his dream.
